actions.name: get_workspace_analytics
actions.description: Get workspace analytics. Read a rolling usage snapshot for current workspace members. Requires an analytics API key. Summary only by default; include_users=true adds paginated member counts. Snapshots refresh approximately every six hours and recalculate the rolling period for current workspace members. Results may change when members leave or source data is deleted.

days.description: Rolling period in days, ending at the snapshot timestamp.

include_users.description: Include a page of members with their role and activity counts, including members with no recorded activity.

page_size.description: Maximum member rows per page when include_users=true.

cursor.description: Continue the member breakdown with the same days and include_users=true. If the snapshot refreshes, restart without a cursor.

actions.name: list_notes
actions.description: List notes. Lists the notes the API key can read, newest first by creation time. Only notes with a generated summary are returned.

created_before.description: Return notes created before this date

created_after.description: Return notes created after this date

updated_after.description: Return notes updated after this date

folder_id.description: A folder's id (fol_...); list_folders lists them

page_size.description: Maximum number of notes to return per page

space_id.description: A space's id (spa_...); list_spaces lists them

actions.name: get_note
actions.description: Get note. Returns one note with its summary, attendees, calendar event and folders. Pass `include=transcript` to add the transcript. A note the key cannot read, or one without a generated summary, returns `NOTE_NOT_FOUND`.

note_id.description: The note's id (not_...); list_notes and search_notes give it

include.description: Include the note transcript in the response. If a workspace admin has turned off transcript access over the API, `transcript` is null. If it is too large to return inline, Get Note returns `TRANSCRIPT_TOO_LARGE`; retrieve it in pages from `/v1/notes/{note_id}/transcript`.

actions.name: get_transcript
actions.description: Get transcript. Retrieve a meeting transcript in pages, including when Get Note returns `TRANSCRIPT_TOO_LARGE`. Pass `from_time` to start partway through, for example at an excerpt from Search transcripts.

note_id.description: The note's id (not_...); list_notes and search_notes give it

cursor.description: The opaque cursor returned by the previous page

from_time.description: Start at the first transcript item that ends after this UTC timestamp, skipping everything earlier. Pass a passage's `start_time` from Search transcripts to read the conversation from that point. It only sets where the first page starts: it is ignored when `cursor` is set, so it is safe to send on every page. A recording transcribed in one piece that Granola has no timings for is returned from the beginning.

page_size.description: The maximum number of transcript items to return

actions.name: list_folders
actions.description: List folders. Lists the folders the API key can read, ordered by name.

page_size.description: Maximum number of folders to return per page

actions.name: list_spaces
actions.description: List spaces. Lists the spaces the API key can access, ordered by name.

page_size.description: The number of spaces to return

actions.name: list_audit_events
actions.description: List audit events. Lists your workspace's audit events, newest first. Requires an Audit API key.

action.description: Return only events with this exact action, or events whose action starts with it followed by a dot (`workspace` returns `workspace.member_added` but not `workspace_automation.created`). Lowercase, as actions are.

occurred_before.description: Return events that occurred before this date. Must fall within the one-year retention window; an earlier date is rejected.

occurred_after.description: Return events that occurred after this date. Must fall within the one-year retention window; an earlier date is rejected.

page_size.description: Maximum number of audit events to return per page

actions.name: create_webhook_endpoint
actions.description: Create webhook endpoint. Registers an HTTPS URL to receive event deliveries. With a Workspace API key the endpoint is workspace-managed: pass `scopes: ["workspace"]`. Delivery follows that key's space limits, and `folder_ids` may only reference folders the key can list.

url.description: The publicly reachable HTTPS URL to deliver events to

scopes.description: Which notes to receive events for. `personal` covers notes you own, notes shared directly with you, and notes in private folders shared with you. `public` covers notes visible to everyone in the workspace. Pass both for both sets of notes. Workspace admins can disable scopes for non-admin members in the workspace's API settings. With a Workspace API key, pass exactly `["workspace"]`; the endpoint uses that key's space limits.

events.description: Event names to subscribe to. Omit to subscribe to all events.

folder_ids.description: Restrict delivery to notes in these folders or any of their subfolders. Accepts folder IDs returned by `GET /v1/folders`, in any casing. Omit to receive events for every note matching `scopes`. With a Workspace API key, folders must also be within that key's space limits. The same filter applies to all subscribed `events`.

actions.name: list_webhook_endpoints
actions.description: List webhook endpoints. Lists the webhook endpoints the API key can manage, oldest first. A Workspace API key limited to selected spaces only lists endpoints created with that exact key. An unrestricted Workspace API key can also list endpoints created by other keys in the same workspace.

actions.name: update_webhook_endpoint
actions.description: Update webhook endpoint. Changes an endpoint's URL, scopes, events, folder filter or enabled state. Fields you leave out stay as they are. A space-limited Workspace API key can only update endpoints created with that exact key. A workspace-managed endpoint keeps its creating key's space limits, regardless of which authorized key edits it.

webhook_endpoint_id.description: The webhook endpoint's id (whe_...); list_webhook_endpoints lists them

url.description: The publicly reachable HTTPS URL to deliver events to. Omit to leave unchanged.

scopes.description: Which notes to receive events for; replaces the current scopes. `personal` covers notes you own, notes shared directly with you, and notes in private folders shared with you. `public` covers notes visible to everyone in the workspace. Pass both for both sets of notes. Workspace admins can disable scopes for non-admin members in the workspace's API settings. A workspace-managed endpoint's scope is fixed: only `["workspace"]` is accepted. Omit to leave unchanged.

events.description: Event names to subscribe to; replaces the current subscriptions. Omit to leave unchanged.

folder_ids.description: Restrict delivery to notes in these folders or any of their subfolders; replaces the current folder filter. Accepts folder IDs returned by `GET /v1/folders`, in any casing. For a workspace-managed endpoint, folders must be within the creating key's space limits, even when another key edits the endpoint. Pass an empty array to remove the folder filter; the key's space limits still apply. Omit to leave unchanged.

enabled.description: Pause (`false`) or resume (`true`) event deliveries. A paused endpoint keeps its configuration and signing secret; events that occur while paused are not delivered later. Omit to leave unchanged.

actions.name: delete_webhook_endpoint
actions.description: Delete webhook endpoint. Deletes a webhook endpoint. Granola stops sending it events. A space-limited Workspace API key can only delete endpoints created with that exact key. An unrestricted Workspace API key can delete endpoints created by other keys in the same workspace.

webhook_endpoint_id.description: The webhook endpoint's id (whe_...); list_webhook_endpoints lists them

actions.name: create_legal_hold
actions.description: Create legal hold. Places a named legal hold on custodians in your workspace. Granola preserves a custodian's notes, transcripts and attachments while any hold covering them is active. Custodians see no change in the product.

name.description: A name for the matter this hold preserves

covers_entire_workspace.description: Whether the hold covers every member of your workspace, current and future. Required: scope is never something a caller falls into.

custodians.description: Users to name individually when the hold is created

email.description: The custodian's email address. Use this when your system knows employees by email rather than by Granola user id.

id.description: The custodian's Granola user id. Case-insensitive.

actions.name: list_legal_holds
actions.description: List legal holds. Lists every legal hold in your workspace, newest first. Released holds are returned alongside active ones, each carrying `released_at`.

page_size.description: Maximum number of legal holds to return per page

actions.name: get_legal_hold
actions.description: Get legal hold. Returns one legal hold. A released hold is still returned, carrying `released_at`.

hold_id.description: The legal hold's id; list_legal_holds lists them

actions.name: update_legal_hold
actions.description: Update legal hold. Renames or re-describes a hold, or widens and narrows its workspace-wide coverage. Toggling coverage never touches the custodians the hold names. A released hold cannot be updated.

hold_id.description: The legal hold's id; list_legal_holds lists them

name.description: A new name for the matter

description.description: New free text for the matter, or null to clear it

covers_entire_workspace.description: Whether the hold covers every member of your workspace. Toggling this never touches the custodians the hold names.

actions.name: release_legal_hold
actions.description: Release legal hold. Releases a hold. Release is terminal: the hold is never deleted, there is no un-release, and a matter that reopens is a new hold. Releasing an already-released hold returns its original `released_at`.

hold_id.description: The legal hold's id; list_legal_holds lists them

actions.name: add_legal_hold_custodians
actions.description: Add legal hold custodians. Names users on a hold, by email or by Granola user id. Idempotent: the response carries the request's full resolved set, whether each entry was newly added or already present.

hold_id.description: The legal hold's id; list_legal_holds lists them

custodians.description: Users to name on this hold

email.description: The custodian's email address. Use this when your system knows employees by email rather than by Granola user id.

id.description: The custodian's Granola user id. Case-insensitive.

actions.name: list_legal_hold_custodians
actions.description: List legal hold custodians. Lists the users a hold names, oldest first. Removed custodians are returned alongside active ones, each carrying `removed_at`.

hold_id.description: The legal hold's id; list_legal_holds lists them

page_size.description: Maximum number of custodians to return per page

actions.name: remove_legal_hold_custodian
actions.description: Remove legal hold custodian. Removes a custodian from a hold. The record of who was held survives: the entry is returned by the list endpoint with `removed_at` set. A custodian id that was never issued returns 404.

hold_id.description: The legal hold's id; list_legal_holds lists them

actions.name: search_notes
actions.description:
Search notes by keyword in their titles and summaries, or filter them by participant, folder, space or date. Private notes and transcripts are not searched.

Recent notes can be missing until their summary is generated; use List notes for a complete listing. Keys with the Notes by ID scope get no results.

keywords.description: Words to search for in titles and summaries. An entry matches when all its words appear in the title or in the summary, in any order; a note needs only one entry to match.

participant.description: Only meetings with this person or company on the calendar invite: a name, email, company or domain. It does not match names mentioned in the notes.

folder_id.description: Only notes in this folder and its child folders. Use List folders to find folder IDs.

space_id.description: Only notes in this space and its folders. Use List spaces to find space IDs. Combines with folder_id.

from_date.description: Only meetings that started at or after this date or UTC timestamp. A date means midnight UTC. Notes without a calendar event use their creation time.

to_date.description: Only meetings that started at or before this date or UTC timestamp. A date means midnight UTC at the start of that day, so it leaves out meetings later that day.

updated_after.description: Only notes whose content or summary changed after this date or UTC timestamp. A date means midnight UTC.

page_size.description: Maximum number of notes to return per page

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous response, to fetch the next page. Send it alone or with page_size. Cursors expire after 15 minutes.

actions.name: search_transcripts
actions.description:
Search transcripts. Search meeting transcripts by keyword to find where something was said. Each result is a note with up to two short excerpts from its transcript; pass an excerpt's start_time to Get transcript as from_time to read the conversation from there.

Recent meetings can be missing until their note's summary is generated. Keys with the Notes by ID scope get no results.

keywords.description: Words to search for. Required unless cursor is set. An entry matches when all its words are said close together, in any order; a note needs only one entry to match. Synonyms and other spellings are not matched, so add them as separate entries.

note_ids.description: Only search these notes. An ID is ignored when no note has it or the API key cannot read that note.

participant.description: Only meetings with this person or company on the calendar invite, or where they are named as a speaker: a name, email, company or domain. A meeting matched only by speaker name returns just the parts where they spoke.

from_date.description: Only meetings that started at or after this date or UTC timestamp. A date means midnight UTC. Notes without a calendar event use their creation time.

to_date.description: Only meetings that started at or before this date or UTC timestamp. A date means midnight UTC at the start of that day, so it leaves out meetings later that day.

page_size.description: Maximum number of notes to return per page

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous response, to fetch the next page. Send it alone or with page_size. Cursors expire after 15 minutes.
